name: a_wrong_mate_is_taken_out
why: BRIEF R22 (25/10/2026). A distance mate put the second half of a channel under the first instead of on top, and it could not be taken out: the state of an assembly listed no mate by name, so «suppress_feature» refused the name, and «delete_feature» waited for a confirmation the client never showed. The state now lists the mates («mates_list», with a uid M1, M2 ... and the name SOLIDWORKS gives), «suppress_mate» turns one off and back on, «delete_mate» deletes it. Measured on 26/10/2026: an assembly of two parts with a coincident and a distance mate read back as Coincidente1 and Distanza1, kinds and components right.
defect_caught: A mate missing from the state, or listed without the components it holds; a suppression that SetSuppression2 answers true and that on re-reading did not happen; a deletion where the mate is still there, or where a uid points to the next mate once the first is gone; a name that does not exist that is not refused.

expect.why: R22: the mates are in the state of the assembly
the uid does not depend on the language of the session
which components it holds, by the uids of the state
read back with IsSuppressed2, not taken from SetSuppression2
the road back: the mate holds again
read back: the name is gone and there is one mate fewer
